effective_date_label: Import-Export Tariff workbook as at 5 April 2026
notes: Bilingual (vi/en) workbook, 39 sheets, 32.3 MB. Sheet BT2026 is the MFN spine: 19,901 rows x 109 columns, 15,119 coded rows, English descriptions on 95.6% of them. Compiled by the Quang Ninh Customs Sub-Department and redistributed via thuvienphapluat.vn — NOT the issuing authority; the authoritative instrument is the MOF/Government Decree enacting the schedule. Contains every 8-digit code of the SG-MY verified AHTN 2022 core (11,413 of 11,413) plus 458 national Chapter 98 additions. Parser not yet written.
